CLIPDeclaration.Name: NI 1486 8 Out CLIP
CLIPDeclaration.Description: The NI 1486 8 Out CLIP exposes serial output CSI-2 data as AXI Stream interfaces, provides read and write access to Serializer GPIO, and provides read-only status indicators for Power Over Coax and other signals.
